page.layout: One column of alphabetical index entries with page numbers at the right. Above the column the running head "INDEX." is centred. Section letters E and F stand as separate lines. Gathering signature "Ll" centred at the foot.

main_text.l: Facere aliquid in nomine Iesu quid 360[?]
Felicitas privata non firma sine publica 160
Fidei unitatem non impediunt externi ritus 271
Fœminæ delicatæ non lactantes filios suos 76
Fœminæ arcani quid credidisse pænituit Catonem 206

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "360" in the F entry "Facere" (printed 36 with a small final figure), "Ejavitæ" (first letters unclear), "בן" in the Hebrew entry "Filii" (the Hebrew is faint), and "383" for "Fons" (the numeral is blurred). The large E at the start of the first entry is an initial letter and is joined to "brietas". The page number is not printed, so none is given. The ampersand is kept as printed.
